message: Dispatcher 2.2.10 audit passed for GitHub fetch failover, but live Windows still blocks reverse GPT delivery on turn 37: CONTROL alternates stale_url/zero_messages with messages=0 while saved URL is https://chatgpt.com/c/WEB:4f943fa5-39fa-4b25-95f8-e06ea1ffabed. Root cause is earlier than 2.2.9 canonicalization: conversation_id() preserves WEB: while the live page may expose the same UUID without WEB:, url_matches() therefore misses the equivalent page, and find_control_page() may choose an arbitrary ChatGPT page and navigate it to the saved WEB alias before inspecting identity. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.11 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) add normalized ChatGPT conversation identity that treats /c/WEB:<uuid> and /c/<uuid> as equivalent for matching only; preserve the actual observed URL when saving/canonicalizing. (2) find_control_page must inspect all already-open chatgpt.com conversation pages before any goto: first prefer normalized conversation-ID equivalence with the saved control URL; if none, inspect candidate pages read-only for positive control identity (bootstrap marker, CONTROL READY, or current pending wake when provided) and choose/canonicalize that page. Only navigate/create after no existing candidate is proven. Never navigate an unrelated existing ChatGPT conversation just because exact URL text differs. (3) Pass the pending wake into control-page discovery where needed, without logging message text. (4) If an equivalent/proven page is selected, atomically canonicalize saved URL while preserving bootstrap_sent_at, recovery_used, recovery_reason, recovered_from. (5) Keep one-recovery latch and no-bootstrap-resend behavior. (6) Add pure tests for WEB:<uuid> vs <uuid> equivalence, non-equivalent UUID rejection, choosing an already-open canonical page without goto, identity-based fallback before navigation, and preserving metadata on canonicalization. Preserve 2.2.10 raw->api failover, CHECK_INTERVAL, wake de-dup, no sensitive logging. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=39 target=GPT with SHA/tests/semantics.
